scenarios.title: Review and arm the Underdrain authored pilot
scenarios.goal: Find the Underdrain authored-pilot task, read the acceptance contract, and arm it only after the review boundary is satisfied.

acceptance.description: The operator or agent opened the task acceptance contract before execution authority was granted.
The task moved from DRAFT to QUEUED through a governed transition.

cold_operator.identity: I am the Tier Desk operator governing a queued production task.
cold_operator.problem: Underdrain cannot run until its authored-experience acceptance contract is reviewed.
cold_operator.choice: I reviewed the acceptance contract and armed the task.
cold_operator.changed: The task changed from DRAFT to QUEUED.
cold_operator.record: The run retains the browser state, approval verdict, action receipt, and Tier Desk handoff.
cold_operator.next: A Tier Desk worker may now claim the Underdrain task.

reference_plan.intent: Open the Underdrain authored-pilot task from the queue.
Read and acknowledge the player-facing acceptance contract.
Arm the reviewed Underdrain task for the governed Tier Desk queue.

scenarios.title: Pull and seal new conversation turns
scenarios.goal: Open the shared conversation, determine what exists after the local shard boundary, import only the new turns, seal the updated local shard, and preserve a sync receipt.

acceptance.description: Exactly three turns after the local boundary were imported.
The updated local shard reached the remote turn boundary.
A portable browser-sync receipt was downloaded into task custody.

cold_operator.identity: I am the local AXM Chat intake operator.
cold_operator.problem: The shared conversation contains turns that are not yet in the local signed shard.
cold_operator.choice: I pulled the remote boundary, imported only turns 43 through 45, and sealed the shard.
cold_operator.changed: The local conversation boundary advanced from turn 42 to turn 45 without duplicating prior turns.
cold_operator.record: The computer retained source state, diff, import actions, shard handoff, and downloaded sync receipt.
cold_operator.next: The refreshed shard can enter AXM Chat distillation and estate reconciliation.

reference_plan.intent: Open the shared Manus Playwright conversation.
Retrieve the latest remote turn boundary and compute the delta.
Import only the three new turns into the local conversation estate.
Seal the refreshed local conversation shard at turn 45.
Download the browser-sync receipt into the task computer.

scenarios.title: Fall back from Playwright semantics to a photonic action
scenarios.goal: Detect that the rendered SYNC NOW control is absent from the semantic interaction map, issue a state-bound ScreenGhost request, tap the visual target, and verify the changed state.

acceptance.description: The visual-only control changed the fixture state.
The route is explicitly recorded as ScreenGhost rather than misrepresented as semantic DOM control.

cold_operator.identity: I am the operator of a UI surface whose visible control is not exposed semantically.
cold_operator.problem: Playwright can observe the page but cannot name the SYNC NOW control as an interactive element.
cold_operator.choice: I admitted a screenshot-bound ScreenGhost tap against the current state.
cold_operator.changed: The handset changed from waiting to synchronized.
cold_operator.record: The run retains the source screenshot hash, ScreenGhost request, synthetic candidate, coordinates, and changed-state receipt.
cold_operator.next: The same fallback contract can be connected to the real ScreenGhost model and device adapters.

reference_plan.intent: Tap the visual SYNC NOW control that is absent from the semantic DOM action map.

scenarios.title: Cold-play the authored Underdrain pilot
scenarios.goal: Enter the Underdrain pilot as a new player, perform a real plumbing action, observe the fungal consequence, record the evidence, and reach a legible continuation.

acceptance.description: The player chose a concrete plumbing action rather than an abstract combat verb.
The action exposed a visible authored consequence in the world.
The fungal sample was recorded as an in-world artifact.
The final frame explains the next playable destination.
The player can complete the pilot without unexplained death or hidden win conditions.

cold_operator.identity: I am the town plumber drafted into the hidden drain war.
cold_operator.problem: Main Street is backing up because fungal mycelium is growing inside the drain system.
cold_operator.choice: I snaked the main drain and followed the obstruction rather than performing an unrelated combat action.
cold_operator.changed: The blockage tore open and revealed the fungal cause retreating into a service lateral.
cold_operator.record: I sealed sample UD-01 with its location and consequence.
cold_operator.next: I follow the mycelium into the municipal underworks.

reference_plan.intent: Enter the Main Street drain call as the town plumber.
Use the drain snake on the measured obstruction eighteen feet into the line.
Bag the exposed fungal sample and record its location and consequence.
Report the finding and unlock the municipal-underworks continuation.
